note: An audience, not a city. Measured 2026-10-14: defining a market by whoever is famous there produces two readings that disagree (New York scored tau 0.13 that way), because a large city holds several audiences under one name. Anchors drawn from a single scene agree far better: New York 0.13 -> 0.91, Tokyo 0.42 -> 0.81, Berlin 0.52 -> 0.73. Each entry carries two anchor sets from the same scene; the agent reads both and reports only what they agree on.

New York · whoever is famous.note: Kept deliberately. This is the incoherent definition the method refuses: three artists who are all from New York but point at three different audiences.
